snippet.title: Sandalwood Simulator | Open World Crime & Logging Survival Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist here : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4789500/Sandalwood_Simulator/?beta=0

Sandalwood Smuggler Simulator is an open-world crime and survival simulation game where you cut valuable sandalwood from deep forests, load it into your vehicle, and transport it through dangerous territories controlled by rival gangs and patrolling police forces.

Manage risk, survive ambushes, and complete illegal deliveries while navigating unpredictable encounters across the forest and roads.

Every run is a high-risk operation — one mistake can cost everything.

Discord : https://discord.gg/TK42RqV5Y7
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/playjas.dev/?hl=en
Reddit : https://www.reddit.com/user/Inevitable-Win-1756/

Gameplay Features:

🌲 Realistic forest logging and cutting system
🚗 Vehicle-based transport and cargo risk mechanics
🚔 Police chase, raids, and interception events
⚔️ Rival gang AI encounters and ambushes
🌍 Open-world survival + crime economy loop
